description:
Use this for the buyer's TOTAL price of ONE listing: an itemized out-the-door DEMO ESTIMATE for the buyer's
state, county and city, built with real public tax and fee rules for the 8 covered states. Lines include the
price, dealer fees, eligible incentives, state and local sales tax, title and registration fees, and a trade-in
block (allowance, payoff, equity, tax credit). Every line has a source and confidence; unknowns become ranges.
Read estimated_out_the_door with estimate_range and confidence. With a trade-in, estimated_out_the_door is the
balance due after the trade (negative equity added); deal.vehicle_out_the_door_before_trade is the car alone.
Use get_price_breakdown instead for only the dealer's listed price and fees, and get_payment_estimate to turn
this total into a monthly finance payment (this tool returns payments: null). Read warnings, for example when the
shopper's state differs from the store's state. Not an offer, not a quote, not penny-accurate. Inputs are not stored.

buyer_city.description: Shopper's city, e.g. Chicago. Some city taxes depend on it; it can also imply the county.
buyer_city.title: Buyer City

buyer_county.description: Shopper's county name without the word County, e.g. Harris, Cook, Orange. Improves local tax lines.
buyer_county.title: Buyer County

buyer_state.description: Shopper's two-letter state; sets the tax and fee state. Defaults to the selling store's state, or the state of buyer_zip. States outside the 8 covered return a low-confidence estimate without tax and government fees.
buyer_state.title: Buyer State

buyer_zip.description: Buyer's five-digit ZIP. Alone it resolves buyer state, county and city (echoed in tax_location.resolution with the source).
buyer_zip.title: Buyer Zip

eligible_incentive_labels.description: label_raw values of conditional incentives from get_price_breakdown that the shopper qualifies for (case-insensitive).
eligible_incentive_labels.title: Eligible Incentive Labels

financed.description: True if the purchase will be financed, false for cash. Some fees and incentives depend on it; if omitted they are flagged as uncertain.
financed.title: Financed

lender_name.description: Lender holding the trade-in loan (optional, not stored).
lender_name.title: Lender Name

payoff.description: Loan payoff in USD still owed on the trade-in.
payoff.title: Payoff

plate_transfer.description: True to transfer existing plates where the state allows it.
plate_transfer.title: Plate Transfer

registration_state.description: State where the car will be registered, if different from buyer_state.
registration_state.title: Registration State

trade_value.description: Trade-in allowance in USD offered or expected for the shopper's car.
trade_value.title: Trade Value

vehicle_weight_lbs.description: Vehicle weight, used by weight-based registration fees.
vehicle_weight_lbs.title: Vehicle Weight Lbs

name: estimate_out_the_door
